text: What if every car on Earth disappeared overnight? Only cars. Buses and trains stay.
Your dad walks to the driveway. Stares at the empty spot. Walks back inside. Walks out again.
Every bus is full. Every bike is sold out by nine. Someone rides a horse to work and goes viral.
The highway is silent. Six lanes, nobody on them. Kids are skateboarding on the Autobahn.
Pizza arrives by bike. Cold. Nobody complains. You hear birds on the main road for the first time.
Parking lots turn into parks, football pitches and night markets. Your street has a basketball court now.
The first new car is built. The waiting list is eleven years long. Your dad still walks to the driveway every morning.
Would you miss your car? Tell me in the comments.
